description: This file contains functions related to applying patches to a Realtek PHY device, including translation of patch operations, executing patches, and processing patch data sequences for network hardware initialization or configuration.

methods.name: uint8 phy_patch_op_translate(uint8 patch_mode,uint8 patch_op,uint8 compare_op)

methods.name: int32 phy_patch(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint8 portOffset,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: Main function to initiate patching process on a PHY device, applying sequences or data patches depending on patch mode.
